newsitem.title: CHINA: Loans for China's grain processing industry.
newsitem.headline: Loans for China's grain processing industry.

text.p: The Chinese government has pledged to extend loans totalling 2.0 billion yuan ($241 million) for the grain processing industry between 1996 and 2000, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The Agricultural Development Bank had extended 400 million yuan in loans in 1996 to revamp grain processing equipment, the newspaper said.
About 320 million yuan was earmarked last year to finance 71 such projects, it said.
There were 14,672 grain processing enterprises under the Ministry of Internal Trade by the end of 1995, it said.
The output value of the enterprises totalled 66.8 billion yuan in 1995, while turnover hit 86.9 billion yuan, the newspaper said. It gave no comparative figures.
The Beijing Grain Bureau hoped to attract foreign investment to overhaul old grain processing enterprises, the newspaper said, but gave no further details.
